name: New Era
verdict: The brand of New Era Cap Company, controlled by its founding Koch family of Buffalo, New York; ACON Investments and the NFL, NBA and MLB hold minority stakes. Nothing found.
note: Official Cap of LIV Golf and shown on every team page (livgolf.com/southern-guards-gc, opened 2026-10-03). The Koch family here is the founding Buffalo family of New Era Cap (Ehrhardt Koch, 1920) - unrelated to Koch Industries: the company is family-owned with fourth-generation CEO Christopher H. Koch (jackierobinson.org bio, opened 2026-10-03). ACON's 2022 ~$700m continuation round made the NFL, NBA and MLB minority investors (frontofficesports.com). No human-rights findings against the company came up.
